notes.subject: משתו
notes.rationale: Crux: 'when he raises himself' (JPS, from שוה) vs KJV/ASV 'they are joined one to another' (from שוה 'chain-row'); KJV follows different verse order.

notes.subject: יתחטאו
notes.rationale: Hithpael of חטא: 'miss the mark / lose hope' (JPS 'beside themselves') vs 'purify themselves'; both senses live in the verb.

notes.subject: lusim tingting
notes.rationale: Rendered 'miss' figuratively as losing one's wits; literal Hebrew is 'miss/sin'.

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks object pronoun; added to mark whose breakers.

translation: Taim em i stairap yet, ol man bilong strong ol i save frait; long ol bikpela breikwara ⟨em⟩ ol i lusim tingting.
